backend/main.mo: Motoko actor with access control managing user profiles and habit data, including creation, completion tracking, and time-volume structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping layout-alignment fixes to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files, components, and UI/theme utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode variables, and global surface styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up React Query, layout structure, authentication controls, and global UI elements.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Glass-styled alert prompting unauthenticated users to sign in, including a login button.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing whether the user is signed in based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button with state-aware behavior and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating habits with optimistic updates and identity-scoped keys.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main authenticated habit-tracking view with month tabs, habit grid, skeleton loading, and error handling.
Renders a skeleton placeholder UI for the habit grid, including month tabs, headers, and row placeholders for loading states.
Displays the habit grid with day columns and habit rows, showing a message when no habits exist.
Defines shared layout constants and helpers for aligning habit grid columns.
Manages creation of new habits with an add button, input field, and mutation handling.
Renders a single habit row with editing for name, unit, and volume, plus per-day completion toggles.
Provides tab controls for switching between months using 2026 month data.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Exports 2026 month metadata and helpers for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Defines habit completion and volume logic, including maps, display formatting, and monthly totals.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Provides validation, parsing, formatting, and normalization utilities for time-based volume strings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading stored identities and handling login state. Wraps AuthClient creation and exposes login, clear, and status helpers.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a light cyber-themed design with custom CSS variables, glass surfaces, and mobile touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider before rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session storage values, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, container settings, and animations using custom CSS variables and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing state, issues, and feature requests related to fixing habit grid alignment.
